authorization_number.sh: For Gratuity (msg type 0009): the authorization number of the original transaction.

card_number.sh: Depends on the transaction scenario: - **Standard Pin Pad transaction:** leave empty.

desired_currency.sh: ISO 4217 Alpha Currency Code in which the transaction will be processed (e.g., "EUR", "USD").

ecr_data.sh: ECR Data field used to transfer user information for private-labeled cards (e.g., Fleet Card Company such as UTA, outex).

language.sh: ISO 639-1 language code used by the Pin Pad user interface during the transaction (e.g., "en", "de", "es").

password.sh: Password - currently not used (filled with spaces).

payment_reasonAsByte.sh: Payment reason represented as a byte array.

personal_id.sh: Identification of the current user of the ECR or Terminal.

transaction_origin_identifier.sh: Transaction origin identifier: - 1 = Face to Face (Customer present) - 2 = MOTO (Customer not present) - 4 = Capture/Completion - 5 = Pre Authorization - 7 = Balance

transaction_origin_indicator.sh: Transaction origin indicator: - 0 = Request for card data on PIN PAD.

transaction_place.sh: The transaction place; the first 5 characters should contain a formatted zip code.

transaction_source_id.sh: Identification number of the authorization source.
